subject: general
question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Sometimes, the nicknames of children, given to them by their loved ones in childhood, give them a true sense of __embarressment__, especially when they are called by those names in front of others.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (embarrassment)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"embarrassment"** means a feeling of self-consciousness, shame, or awkwardness. (शर्मिंदगी)

 
 
• **Example: **She felt deep embarrassment when she forgot her lines during the presentation.
 
 
 
• Correct spelling: **"embarrassment"** has a double "r" and a double "s" to properly form the word. (शर्मिंदगी)
 
 
• **Example: **His embarrassment was visible when his friends teased him about his nickname.
 
 
 
• The word is widely used in contexts where someone feels ashamed or awkward due to a certain situation.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (embarrassment)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: emmbersment **(गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling and does not exist in English.
 
• **Option 2: embrassment **(गलत वर्तनी): This is a misspelled version of "embarrassment" missing key letters.
 
• **Option 4: embarresmint **(गलत वर्तनी): This is another incorrect spelling that mixes unnecessary letters.
